title: ReFlow: Replay-Driven Decoupling for Efficient RL Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.21640v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has been a critical paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) reasoning and agentic capabilities, but its efficiency remains a major bottleneck. Existing RL systems commonly rely on asynchronous execution to overlap rollout generation with policy optimization for enhanced efficiency. However, this approach faces inherent limitations: mild policy staleness offers only limited training efficiency gains, whereas aggressive asynchrony can degrade model quality and yields diminishing efficiency gains. The dynamic nature of LLM RL and multi-turn agentic workloads further challenges RL system design, as resource demands shift over time, making static resource allocation and generation strategy inefficient.   This paper presents ReFlow, a system-algorithm co-designed RL framework for efficient LLM post-training. translated_title: ReFlow：面向高效强化学习后训练的重放驱动解耦方法
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）推理与智能体能力的关键范式，但其效率仍然是一个主要瓶颈。现有RL系统通常依赖异步执行，将rollout生成与策略优化重叠以提升效率。然而，这种方法存在固有限制：轻微的策略过时只能带来有限的训练效率提升，而激进的异步化则会降低模型质量，且效率收益递减。LLM强化学习及多轮智能体工作负载的动态特性进一步挑战了RL系统的设计，因为资源需求随时间变化，使得静态的资源分配和生成策略变得低效。本文提出ReFlow，一个系统与算法协同设计的高效LLM后训练强化学习框架。其核心洞察是：与现有RL框架仅将每条轨迹使用一次不同，（摘要在此处截断，未完整提供后续内容）
tldr: ReFlow通过重放驱动的解耦机制与系统-算法协同设计，突破传统异步执行效率受限和资源需求动态变化的瓶颈，显著提升大语言模型强化学习后训练的效率。
en_tdlr: ReFlow is a system-algorithm co-designed RL framework that leverages replay-driven decoupling to overcome the efficiency limits of asynchronous execution and dynamic resource demands in LLM RL post-training.
